references.observations: 202 m including antenna, 50 floors, completion 1999; two interlocked fully glazed cylinders with platinum-mirrored solar-control glass. Owner exterior photograph inspected for stepped cylindrical body, taller rear spine, raked glass hood and mast proportions.

Office grid 1.40 m, clear room height 2.75–2.80 m, office depth 4.9–5.5 m and typical leasable floor area 840–900 square metres. Published plan inspected: twin circles, nine-lift central core and projecting rectangular service spine. Plan is a reference, not a surveyed registration drawing.

Two interlocking cylinders; articulated concave seam; oblique river orientation; tower on columns; glass hood with lamella screen. Inspected design sketch, site collage, river panorama, street side photograph, downward facade view and seam close-up. These show narrow silver mullions, blue-gray spandrel glazing and projecting transoms. Street photograph resolves paired braced masts and the rear spine rising above the hood. Plaza interior images show a separate adjoining mall roof.
202 m tower, 50 floors, two-storey shopping centre and 14 m glazed plaza, with separate six-storey residential complex. Neighboring structures are outside this tower-only asset.
2017 lobby renovation uses white and brown sculptural shells. Full renovated interior is not represented.
